verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own case management raises risk alerts for human review. Reviewers can prioritise, filter by customer risk, assign cases and record decisions such as 'risk detected - offboard', and the risk-score equation and screening configurations are configurable. That covers routing findings to humans, but nothing shows policy controls that limit automatic remediation or route only ambiguous or high-risk findings to a person. missing for 10: policy-based limits on automatic remediation, documented auto-resolve vs. escalate thresholds, explicit escalation rules for ambiguous findings, independent corroboration.
